fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant scanned a QR code shared by a caller who spoke of a refund, and Rs. 18,500 was debited instead. The matter was brought to Coimbatore South PS on 2025-11-18, while the incident was placed on 2025-11-18 at roughly 09:45. Hariharan Prakash (mobile 9000000017) was named as a possible person of interest. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100018. A further person, Meena Sekar, a person who arranged the contact, using the number 9000000196, is stated to be associated with the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots, digital documents and a call detail reference.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Social media screenshot; Digital document; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, morning, mobile number, suspect, receiving account, associate, shopping complex
